notes.title: Trouble at The Tall House & OST Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36707411/4e149fa3d9a47c71149a4270f5c1d6102186adb5.png[/img]

Presenting: Trouble at The Tall House — a major new content expansion for Catlandia: Crisis at Fort Pawprint.

Continue your adventure right where you left off! After a nice little nap, a mysterious note arrives at Fort Pawprint, speaking of more terrible dogs setting up camp at a construction yard. Nugget and Sausage must travel to this new area and take down two new fearsome foes — and uncover the truth of what's in store for Fort Pawprint and the Cat Kingdom itself.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36707411/212389fac6a4ad31bc6e73e6cff9fa21fb7e3a09.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36707411/f9ece50285e11689e4309e97e65265dad254b2b7.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36707411/138dd85c95dc680128d0693e5b494a75b72194c1.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36707411/ca08c5818f79dc3421dcce1445e56b96e743ea28.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36707411/2d10c6e78d61226f127f0d112f760609d207c74c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36707411/87cff96688fc595bff95d02090ca99b329675d2c.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36707411/2b1b05934aa213bb0c7bf1bc836f3b10441fb223.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36707411/01533c76251dc257d3b005ec125f114eb5d96e98.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36707411/36b209091da6c78ea95beb3d78923b02fd52fca8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36707411/3983da2a2acbe15cb54f57335e9ea9188b4d14d8.png[/img][/url]

[list]
[*] [b]New areas! [/b]Explore new environments as you travel through a construction yard to gain access to the roof of the tallest building around
[*] [b]New enemies![/b] Fight powered up enemies, as well as the brutal Bull Dozer and sleazy Jack Hammer
[*] [b]New outfits![/b] Collect additional outfits for your adorable cats
[*] [b]Fast travel![/b] Zip around to previously explored areas without all that pesky walking
[*] [b]New story content![/b] Continue the Catlandia story and uncover the true dog threat
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36707411/4afd02883847578b7b3721379d1a58f28a532df1.jpg[/img]

[h2]HALLOWEEN BONUS!
[/h2]
Since it's spooky season, we've added a time-limited Halloween event! Open up Catlandia while connected to the internet, and head to Fort Pawprint to claim a special prize!

[h2]How to access the new content[/h2]

To start the new story content, you'll need to have a save at the end of the game (or start a new game and replay the magic). While the quest Maintain Peace is active, you'll have a new objective of taking a nap. Doing so will trigger the new content.

[h2]How much does this new story content cost?[/h2]

Uuuuh it's totally free!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36707411/dc2f8a6b73724e85d9b00a5b0b66d9ba6d9bdd2f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Catlandia Soundtrack Released![/h2]

On top of this story update, the Catlandia Soundtrack is now available for additional purchase! It contains 29 tracks, with music both from the original release and the Trouble at The Tall House update. If you loved our awesome tunes while playing, pick it up and enjoy more than 90 minutes of great music!

notes.title: 1.05 Update: Minimap, Hints, Tutorial, and more!
notes.content:
Catlandia v1.05 is here! We expect this to be our first and last major update to the underlying mechanics of the game. We've listened to player feedback and developed a number of features that we think will bring you a more satisfying experience.

We will continue to fix bugs and tweak minor things that don't feel quite right of course, but in terms of experience, this will be the only major update that affects the game overall. So you're clear to play Catlandia in its best form right now.

[i]That doesn't mean we won't have a super cool announcement coming soon![/i]

[h2]Tutorial Battle[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36707411/ea98a37c85afea15be8a3f419850d091292615b0.png[/img]
We definitely heard that many people wanted a clearer introduction to the combat system. There are hints that show up in combat, there's a note, and there's a reference panel you can access. But now we've added a tutorial battle!

This is accessible at the start of the game (so existing save files will not encounter it). And it takes place right in Fort Pawprint. The tutorial explains the basics of the combat system.

[h2]Minimap[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36707411/07b8ecfe41ebb6ba09910a372055ad3f3b5cc534.png[/img]
Some of the areas of Catlandia are fairly large, and navigation could get difficult. To solve that, we're introducing a minimap. It will display the player's position, the location of NPCs, and objective markers for active quests.

With this addition, getting around Catlandia and keeping track of where you need to be going will be much easier.

[h2]Quest Reminders and Game Hints[/h2]

Going into the quest menu can be a drag. So we've also included a feature that will pop up a quest reminder every so often. Along with them, you also get game hints to better explain what you can do and how to do it.

[h2]Difficulty[/h2]

We balanced Catlandia like a classic RPG with enemies increasing in level by area to account for a player's progress.

That play style doesn't suit everyone, though. So we've added a new option for Adaptive Difficulty, which will allow the player to fight fewer battles while still getting through the story.

[h2]Options Menu[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36707411/cb733c0866c7e05f2813e516089c92dcbaaaedbe.png[/img]
To handle many of these new features, we'd added an options menu. Open it up to hide the hints if you don't want to see them, hide the combat hints, and change the difficulty.

We've also added a volume control!

[h2]Additional bug fixes[/h2]

This update also fixes a collection of minor text errors, a bug that would prevent music playing in certain situations, and a bug that would not correctly track save times and dates.

notes.title: Catlandia 1.01 Update
notes.content:
Today, we're releasing V1.01. There are two significant changes to mention:

[h2]Save Slots[/h2]

Rather than just a single Autosave, you can now manually save your game to three different save slots. So, if you're worried about a particular battle or just want to check out different conversation options, feel free to make a save! You can save anywhere on the field, and can load from the Title Screen.

And don't worry, Autosave is still there in a reserved slot.

If you're updating from the launch version, this update will create a new save file based on your autosave in Slot 1. The time played stat will be set to 0 — since we weren't actually tracking this until now.

[h2]Combat Difficulty[/h2]

We've heard from many players that the first boss encounter can be pretty tough. We had another look and agree. We've changed an attack that could disable both players to target only one at a time. And we've adjusted their resistance to the Exposure mechanic.

We think these changes will make this first fight a lot more accessible and give you a clearer chance to engage with the combat system. If you do still have trouble, Sausage will also give you a useful tip right before you fight them again.

There are a number of other small fixes in this update, but those are the big two! Thanks for playing — we look forward to hearing from more players!
